schema:
CREATE TABLE incidents (
  case_number,
  date,
  location,
  officers,
  subject_count,
  subject_statuses,
  subject_weapon,
  subjects
);

CREATE TABLE officers (
  case_number,
  first_name,
  full_name,
  gender,
  last_name,
  race
);

CREATE TABLE subjects (
  case_number,
  first_name,
  full_name,
  gender,
  last_name,
  race
);
